overview.description: The MFS Active Growth ETF (MFSG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of US and non-US growth stocks of any market capitalization. The fund utilizes a bottom-up fundamental approach to select investments MFSG was launched on Dec 5, 2024 and is issued by MFS.

data.title: MFS Enters Active ETF Market
data.text: BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--MFS® today launched the firm's first actively managed exchange-traded funds, marking its entry into the fast-growing active ETF market, which now accounts for nearly $700 bill...

holdings.infoBox: MFSG is an equity ETF with a total of 70 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 14.44%, Alphabet at 11.06%, Apple at 6.16%, Microsoft at 5.21%, and Broadcom at 3.23%.
